message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases and duplicate entries were consolidated. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-12 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-13 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-13 05:10 IST through 2026-10-14 05:10 IST**).

New, credible findings were confirmed for monitored Microsoft products, Mozilla Firefox, MongoDB Server, and Ubuntu. Immediate review is recommended, led by the actively exploited Windows zero-day and the high-severity MongoDB, Firefox, and Microsoft disclosures.

### Finding 1 — Actively exploited Windows Shell zero-day

- **Product:** Windows 10 / Windows Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-96951
- **Severity:** Important; CVSS 8.8
- **Description:** A Windows Shell flaw can let a malicious file bypass Mark of the Web protections after social engineering. Microsoft reports exploitation in the wild, and CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 13.
- **Relevance:** Windows 10 and Windows Server 2012 R2 are explicitly monitored.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96951), [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security monthly rollup](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/microsoft-security-advisory-october-2026-monthly-rollup)

### Finding 2 — .NET Framework security-feature bypass

- **Product:** Microsoft .NET Framework
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-108398
- **Severity:** Important; CVSS 8.8
- **Description:** An authenticated attacker can register a crafted .NET assembly for loading by a protected process, potentially bypassing Windows Defender Application Control. The flaw was publicly disclosed before a patch was available.
- **Relevance:** Microsoft .NET and multiple .NET Framework/runtime entries are monitored.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-108398), [Tenable October 2026 analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsofts-october-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-1407-cves-cve-2026-96951)

### Finding 3 — Active Directory Domain Services remote code execution

- **Product:** Windows Server / Active Directory Domain Services
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-70229
- **Severity:** Critical; CVSS 8.1
- **Description:** A crafted network packet sent to AD DS may allow code execution on a vulnerable domain controller. Microsoft assesses exploitation as more likely.
- **Relevance:** Windows Server and Additional Domain Controller are in the combined monitored scope.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70229), [Tenable October 2026 analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsofts-october-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-1407-cves-cve-2026-96951)

### Finding 4 — Broad October Microsoft security release

- **Products:** Windows 10, Windows Server 2012 R2, .NET, Microsoft Office/Outlook, SQL Server, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, PowerShell, Windows Defender, and other monitored Microsoft components
- **Issue:** October 2026 Patch Tuesday; 1,407 CVEs reported by Tenable, including 69 Critical and 1,337 Important
- **Severity:** Critical through Low
- **Description:** The October release includes remote-code-execution, privilege-escalation, security-bypass, information-disclosure, denial-of-service, and spoofing fixes. The monitored-product subset includes 25 .NET CVEs, 22 SQL Server CVEs, numerous Office and Windows issues, and ten Important Visual Studio Code CVEs.
- **Relevance:** The affected-product list overlaps extensively with both assigned primary files.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft October 2026 release notes](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/releaseNote/2026-Oct), [Tenable October 2026 analysis](https://www.tenable.com/blog/microsofts-october-2026-patch-tuesday-addresses-1407-cves-cve-2026-96951)

### Finding 5 — Firefox 158 security vulnerabilities

- **Product:** Mozilla Firefox
- **Issue:** MFSA 2026-106; 55 CVEs fixed in Firefox 158
- **Severity:** High, Moderate, and Low
- **Description:** Mozilla fixed 21 High-impact issues, including use-after-free flaws, sandbox escapes, privilege escalation, boundary errors, information disclosure, and JIT miscompilation, plus 34 Moderate/Low issues.
- **Relevance:** Mozilla Firefox is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Mozilla Foundation Security Advisory 2026-106](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-106/)

### Finding 6 — MongoDB mongos bulk-write authorization flaw

- **Product:** MongoDB Server / mongos
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-104005
- **Severity:** CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** MongoDB disclosed incorrect authorization in the sharded-cluster router for bulk writes to system namespaces.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB Server and Community Server are explicitly monitored.
- **Affected versions:** MongoDB 8.3 before 8.3.13 and 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Source:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 7 — MongoDB collection-validator crash

- **Product:** MongoDB Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-104004
- **Severity:** CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** Collection validators using expressions that accept collations can crash MongoDB Server during insertion.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB Server and Community Server are explicitly monitored.
- **Affected versions:** MongoDB 8.3 before 8.3.13, 8.0 before 8.0.34, and 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Source:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 8 — MongoDB aggregation value misinterpretation

- **Product:** MongoDB Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-103965
- **Severity:** CVSS 5.3
- **Description:** Fixed values in the aggregation `$bucket` stage may be interpreted as field references, producing incorrect behavior.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB Server and Community Server are explicitly monitored.
- **Affected versions:** MongoDB 7.0 before 7.0.45, 8.0 before 8.0.34, 8.3 before 8.3.13, and 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Source:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 9 — MongoDB mongos denial of service

- **Product:** MongoDB Server / mongos
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-96299
- **Severity:** CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** A missing authorization check on an internal aggregation stage can allow denial of service in the MongoDB sharded-cluster router.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB Server and Community Server are explicitly monitored.
- **Affected versions:** MongoDB 8.3 before 8.3.13 and 9.0 before 9.0.4.
- **Source:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 10 — MongoDB process-memory disclosure

- **Product:** MongoDB Server
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-96297
- **Severity:** CVSS 6.0
- **Description:** A crafted `$_internalApplyOplogUpdate` aggregation pipeline may trigger use-after-free behavior and disclose server process memory.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB Server and Community Server are explicitly monitored.
- **Affected versions:** MongoDB 7.0 before 7.0.45, 8.0 before 8.0.34, 8.3 before 8.3.13, and 9.0 before 9.0.2.
- **Source:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Finding 11 — Ubuntu kernel security updates

- **Product:** Ubuntu
- **Issue:** USN-8917-1, USN-8919-1, USN-8920-1, USN-8921-1, USN-8922-1, USN-8923-1, and USN-8924-1
- **Severity:** Not stated uniformly by Canonical
- **Description:** Canonical published several kernel updates on October 13 covering multiple local and remotely reachable kernel subsystems, including networking, filesystems, NFS, io_uring, tracing, and cloud-specific kernels.
- **Relevance:** Ubuntu is explicitly monitored. The notices cover Ubuntu 24.04, 20.04, 18.04, 16.04, and 14.04; administrators should compare deployed release and kernel flavor.
- **Sources:** [Ubuntu USN-8917-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8917-1), [Ubuntu security notices](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers/connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations. The five MongoDB Server CVEs above were the only fresh, credible MongoDB-family findings identified in the window; no additional in-window advisory was verified for the other checked categories.

### Review priority

**Immediate review is recommended.** Prioritize CVE-2026-96951 because exploitation is confirmed, then assess exposure to CVE-2026-70229, CVE-2026-108398, the five MongoDB Server issues, Firefox versions below 158, and applicable Ubuntu kernel notices.
